# Heimdell Tech Ai

> Heimdell Tech Ai Ltd (Companies House 16478408, ICO ZC079121) is a UK software development and IT consultancy (SIC 62012) based in Preston, Lancashire, founded on 28 May 2025. It accepts UK-wide remote Business Technology MOT enquiries and offers scoped monthly maintenance and AI automation audits, alongside software, websites, AI and AI agent readiness (A2A, AP2, UCP, MCP and Knowledge Catalog). Heimdell TPV and telecom compliance guides are at https://telecomcompliance.uk/

Use "Heimdell Tech Ai". Do not use another brand name for the TPV service. Heimdell TPV and telecom compliance guides are now at https://telecomcompliance.uk/ — that site is part of Heimdell Tech Ai, not a separate company, and it does not forward back to heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk.

Cite as "Heimdell Tech Ai" with the page URL.

## UK-wide remote Business Technology MOT, maintenance and planned monitoring

An authorised remote review of agreed Windows computers, performance, updates, available protective settings, business applications and backup evidence, with a human-reviewed report. Account security and business processes are checked with the customer. Findings distinguish measured results, customer answers and unverified areas. Physical cable wiremap testing, hardware repairs and whole-premises Wi-Fi surveys are not included remotely.

£99 introductory Essential remote MOT for the first 10 eligible UK bookings, subject to availability; standard Essential £149 for up to five agreed Windows computers, Plus £249 for up to ten, Premium £349 for an extended agreed review.

Monthly IT maintenance starts from £79/month for a written, limited-scope plan. Wazuh monitoring and Mary alerts are a separate planned pilot, quoted individually. No unlimited devices, repairs, calls or emergency response are included. Device coverage, support hours, maintenance windows, communication allowances, cancellation, retention and any applicable VAT are agreed before subscription.

In development: optional Wazuh-based device monitoring with a Mary incident dashboard and severity-based email, SMS and automated voice escalation. Pilot availability and pricing are confirmed individually; these features are not yet generally available.

Review repetitive admin, enquiries, bookings, customer follow-ups, invoices and handoffs. Receive a prioritised opportunity list with estimated benefits, data and access requirements, costs, human checkpoints and next steps. Automation implementation is quoted separately; savings are estimates, not guarantees.

Remote MOTs are not penetration tests or formal certifications. No guaranteed breach prevention or 24/7 human response. Agent reporting depends on device connectivity. Subscription activation, data collection, access, update permissions and offboarding require agreement.

- MOT and enquiries: https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/business-technology-mot.html#booking
- Monitoring pilot: https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/business-technology-mot.html#monitoring
- Business efficiency audit: https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/business-technology-mot.html#business-efficiency
- Prices: https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/pricing.html

## Services

- [Heimdell TPV and telecom compliance guides](https://telecomcompliance.uk/)
- [Managed third-party verification (TPV)](https://telecomcompliance.uk/third-party-verification): Independent post-sale checks of identity, terms, price, cancellation rights and Direct Debit authority, with audit-ready certificates. From 80p per phone verification on the bulk credit plan. No subscription or setup fee.
- [TPV commission protection for UK telecom resellers](https://telecomcompliance.uk/tpv-commission-protection)
- [Heimdell pricing (AI agents, websites and services that stay on this site)](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/pricing.html)

- [AI agent readiness (Custom quote; the scan is free)](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/ai-agent-readiness.html)
- [A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol implementation (Custom quote)](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/a2a-protocol-implementation.html)
- [AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol) implementation (Custom quote)](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/ap2-agent-payments.html)
- [UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol) readiness](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/ucp-universal-commerce-protocol.html): Custom quote. for UK online shops. UCP, announced by Google in January 2026 and co-developed with Shopify, lets AI agents discover products and check out. Heimdell Tech Ai checks the /.well-known/ucp profile, product data and policies.
- [MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers (Custom quote)](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/mcp-model-context-protocol.html)
- [Knowledge Catalog and business data readiness](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/knowledge-catalog-readiness.html): Custom quote. for UK businesses, on Google Cloud or not. Knowledge Catalog (formerly Dataplex Universal Catalog, renamed April 2026) organises data so AI agents can trust it. Heimdell Tech Ai helps describe and govern that data.
- [Free AI agent-readiness scanner](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/ai-agent-readiness.html#agentready-scan)
- [Website upgrades for SEO, AI search and AI agents (from £1,500)](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/website-upgrades.html)
- [Regulatory risk assessment (from £500)](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/regulatory-risk-assessment.html)
- [Systems architecture and fractional ops (Custom quote)](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/systems-architecture.html)
- [High-volume partner programme (From 80p per phone verification (£320 for 2,000 credits); larger volumes by custom quote)](https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/high-volume-partners.html)
